answer: Payment attaches to a finished task, not a registered address. The agent commits a hash of its receipt before work and reveals it after. Credit unlocks once three peers from unrelated clusters replay the output and match it. A clone adds a hash and no confirmation, so each extra identity in the grove needs its own outside reviewer. The lantern is the published receipt: it only lights after the work exists, and a zephyr of audits moves through the whole farm at once.
